speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, elevated LDH, and a normal ESR/CRP is highly characteristic of this condition, particularly given the rapid onset of abdominal pain suggesting possible nodal involvement.
